title: Velocity of A
description: Essential: The final answer for v_A must be √(5gR).

title: Velocity of B
description: Essential: The final answer for v_B must be 2√(5gR).

title: Spring Energy
description: Essential: The final expression for E_p must be 2.5 m_A g R + 10 m_B g R.

title: Energy Conservation for A
description: Important: Must apply energy conservation between the spring release and the top of the semicircle, correctly relating v_A to the speed at the top (√(gR)).

title: Energy Conservation for B
description: Important: Must apply energy conservation for ball B's ascent on the incline, equating initial kinetic energy to potential energy gain m_B g (10R).

title: Spring Energy Summation
description: Important: Must correctly sum the kinetic energies of both balls at release to find the total initial elastic potential energy.

title: Centripetal Condition
description: Important: Must state or use the condition that at the top of the loop, the normal force is zero, leading to m_A g = m_A v_top² / R.

title: Sign or Unit Error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in energy equations or missing/incorrect units (e.g., omitting 'g' or 'R') in final expressions.

title: Misapplied Energy Path
description: Pitfall: Using the wrong height (e.g., 2R instead of 10R for B, or incorrect potential energy change for A on the semicircle).
